serviceAccounts.intro: A service account is the account of a program, such as a CI job or a scheduled load: it signs in with an API token, never with a passkey. It can do nothing until it has a grant.
serviceAccounts.name: Name
serviceAccounts.nameHelp: The name its grants and tokens name it by. It must not be taken, in any letter case, and cannot be changed later.
serviceAccounts.created: Created the service account {{name}}. It can do nothing until it has a grant.

deactivate.title: Deactivate
deactivate.intro: For someone who leaves, or an account no longer needed. It cannot be undone in this release.
deactivate.endsPerson: {{name}} can no longer sign in. Every session of theirs ends now, their personal API tokens and the task tokens made with them stop working, and their open sign-in links are withdrawn, as are the invites and recovery links they issued.
deactivate.endsService: The API tokens of {{name}} and the task tokens made with them stop working, and runs that act as {{name}} fail.
deactivate.endsOwn: You can no longer sign in: this session ends at once, and your personal API tokens and the task tokens made with them stop working.
deactivate.kept: Its grants, group memberships and audit entries stay on record.
deactivate.final: This cannot be undone in this release: nobody can reactivate {{name}}, and the name stays taken.
deactivate.held: Type the name exactly to deactivate.
deactivate.note: {{name}} is deactivated: they cannot sign in, and their tokens do not work.
